metal.source_kappa: C14/constant/metal/materials/castIron transport.mu=5.5e-3, Pr=0.14 and thermo.Cp=827; derived k=mu*Cp/Pr

simulation.source_time_choices: C14/system/controlDict: deltaT=0.001 s, endTime=10 s, writeInterval=100 time steps, adjustTimeStep=no

physics_limitations: All numeric inputs are read from C14 source case; no QuickCup measurement or 3D CFD validation is inferred.
Metal C14 model is heRhoThermo/hConst/sensibleEnthalpy with Cp 827, NOT a heSolidThermo Cv; T0 TWO-SOLID uses clearly tagged Cp_as_effective_Cv surrogate ONLY.
Metal conductivity k=mu*Cp/Pr is derived from C14 constant transport; not explicitly tabulated in C14.
C14 h=10 ambient 300 K, metal emissivity .3, mold .5 and finite interfacial 0.0002m/.1WmK applied to T0; NOT an adiabatic closed energy-balance model.
Any standalone insulated equilibrium analytical calculation is counterfactual and MUST NOT be used as acceptance criterion with C14 convective walls.
C14 phase change latent heat, buoyancy, fluid velocity, p_rgh and 2D empty BC are preserved in baseline, but deliberately ABSENT from 3D solid-solid numerical T0.
Actual T0 native run, parser checks on local WSL and physical comparison still pending; do not call the model C14 equivalent.
